title: Association Between Response to Treatment of C. Diff Colitis and Anti-C.Diff Toxin Antibody
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is three fold: 1)To collect serum from patients with documented Clostridium difficile infection and test for the presence of antibody to C. difficile toxin at the start and at the end of therapy, and again if a relapse or recurrence occurs. 2)To collect stool samples for test of C. difficile toxin at similar time intervals. 3)To assay random serum samples from the VA lab in order to determine the rate of antibody to C. difficile toxin in our patient population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients at the Houston VA with documented C. difficile infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
